messages.subject: Bioinformatics job opportunity at UW-Madison
parts:
Great Lakes Bioenergy Research Center is looking for a Bioinformatics Scientist to join its Bioinformatics Core Group at the University of Wisconsin - Madison.  Minimal education and experience requirements include a Ph.D. in Bioinformatics or a related field, including biological sciences, statistics, computer science, mathematics or physical sciences, plus at least 3 years of bioinformatics work experience, including thesis work, post-doctoral and/or professional experience.  Expertise in NGS data analysis, integration of data from different “omics” assay types, and/or systems biology is preferred.

See further details and application instructions at http://www.ohr.wisc.edu/pvl/pv_073320.html

Unless confidentiality is requested in writing, information regarding applicants and nominees must be released upon request.  Finalists cannot be guaranteed confidentiality.

The University of Wisconsin-Madison is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer.
